label: Scottish statutory instruments made from 1999 to 2026 and UK statutory instruments made from 1987 to 2026
not_covered: statutory instruments made before 1987 (held by legislation.gov.uk only as scanned images); Northern Ireland Statutory Rules, a series of their own (Welsh statutory instruments and Northern Ireland Orders in Council carry UK SI numbers and are held under them); instruments published on legislation.gov.uk without their text (mostly temporary traffic orders); instruments made under an EU regulation or another Order rather than an Act; and any instrument published after the last refresh
source: legislation.gov.uk as-made XML preambles; tools/madeunder_probe.py (FIX_PLAN P3.31)

revocations.source: legislation.gov.uk's Changes to Legislation record, the affected feeds of the SSI type and of each UK SI year; tools/revocation_harvest.py (FIX_PLAN P3.33)
